answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jetty of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The shale holds work receipts rather than names, so the kernel of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
